landing.title: Build plans for The Wagyu Tavern WhatsApp bot
landing.lede: The paid client deliverable behind the whatsapp-demo prototype: a production WhatsApp customer-service bot for The Wagyu Tavern — real corpus-derived data, conversation logging, a staff-template reservation flow, an admin UI with hot-reload content editing, and a human-approved self-improvement loop. Each plan below is a sequence of disciplined TDD cycles.
